title: xebench raw reference session, schemaVersion 1
description: One ReferenceSession record as written by xebenchapp/src/harness/session.ts (checkpoint or terminal), schemaVersion 1. The protocol version selects a branch: cpu-reference-v1 records (including those from apps built before condition snapshots) keep their original shape; cpu-reference-v2 records carry readiness, sampling, order and verdict evidence; cpu-reference-v3 records add build identity, configuration source and hash, effective engine settings, per-load engine reports and the configured model hash. Cross-field rules, including recomputed condition assessments, are enforced by scripts/raw_session.py. Per-attempt conditions, conditionPolicy, protocol and configuration stay open to additive fields. accelerator-v1 records (sessionAcceleratorV1, frozen) add LiteRT-LM, GPU/NPU backends, observed-backend evidence and the output-correctness gate; accelerator-v2 (sessionAcceleratorV2) adds the cpu-reference-v3 build and execution identity.

label.description: Mirrors config.ts: not blank after JS trim(), no C0 control characters.

configuration.description: The parsed configuration echoed into the record. Open to additive fields.

completeAttempt.description: A successful repetition: metrics are flattened beside runIndex/conditions/status.

attemptConditions.description: Endpoint observations. Open to additive fields (readiness, sampling, run kind).

aggregate.description: Median and IQR use linear interpolation at index (n - 1) * p over successful repetitions.

observedBackend.description: Actual backend execution is not observed; unknown stays null.

protocol.description: Open to additive fields (run kind, sampling, order) from later protocol work.

guardsPassed.description: Never true in v1: passing endpoint checks is not protocol validation.

conditionPolicy.description: Open to additive fields from condition-enforcement work.

sessionV1.description: Protocol cpu-reference-v1 (harness xebench-0.5-reference), unchanged so historical evidence still validates. One ReferenceSession record as written by xebenchapp/src/harness/session.ts (checkpoint or terminal). Structural rules only; cross-field rules (repetition count, status vs attempts, recomputed summaries, configuration agreement, guard consistency) are enforced by scripts/raw_session.py. Per-attempt conditions, conditionPolicy, protocol and configuration are intentionally open to additive fields. Records from apps built before condition snapshots (PR #11) omit conditionPolicy and every attempt's conditions; the validator accepts all or none.

artifact.description: null only for runs recorded without measurement (stopReason setup-failed or configuration-aborted).

observedBackend.description: Actual backend execution is not observed; unknown stays null.

protocol.description: Open to additive fields (run kind, sampling, order) from later protocol work.

guardsPassed.description: Never true: backend execution is unverified even when conditionVerdict passes.

sessionV2.description: Protocol cpu-reference-v2 (harness xebench-0.6-reference): readiness-gated, sampled repetitions under run-conditions-v2 and charging-policy-v2 (docs/RUN-CONDITIONS.md).

expectedSha256.description: The configured run's modelSha256, or null when the configuration names none.

artifact.description: Bytes hashed before measurement. null only for runs recorded before hashing (stopReason setup-failed or configuration-aborted); a model-hash-mismatch run keeps both hashes.

observedBackend.description: Actual backend execution is not observed; unknown stays null.

protocol.description: Open to additive fields (run kind, sampling, order) from later protocol work.

guardsPassed.description: Never true: backend execution is unverified even when conditionVerdict passes.

executionReports.description: One engine report per successful model load, in load order. Reports are what the engine said, not verified execution; observedBackend stays null.

sessionV3.description: Protocol cpu-reference-v3 (harness xebench-0.7-reference): the cpu-reference-v2 measurement procedure plus build identity, configuration source and hash, the engine's effective settings, per-load engine reports and the configured model hash (docs/REFERENCE-RUNS.md).

buildIdentity.description: Embedded at build time (BuildConfig) and read through the BuildInfo native module. status unavailable means the module was missing and every other field is null; a reported field the build could not determine is null.

configurationSource.description: bundled: the APK's configs/cpu-reference-v1.json, hashed at build time (null if the build did not report it). staged: xebench-config.json, hashed as read.

effectiveSettingsLlamaRn.description: Every parameter the harness passes to llama.rn initLlama() (besides the model path) and completion() (besides the prompt). Unlisted parameters are the binding's defaults for engineVersion.

distribution.description: The binding as installed: the npm package as published, with no patches applied. Absent in records from apps built before it was recorded.

executionReport.description: What llama.rn reported about the context created by one load: GPU placement and why not, devices used, the native library variant, llama.cpp's system_info line and the mapped native libraries' build IDs. Unreported or malformed values are null.

nativeLibraries.description: llama.rn native libraries mapped in the process after the load, with their ELF GNU build IDs (null when unreadable). Absent in records from apps built before it was recorded; null when the app could not report.

completeAttemptV2.description: A successful repetition: metrics are flattened beside runIndex/conditions/status.

skippedAttempt.description: A repetition that never loaded a model because readiness timed out.

conditionPolicyV2.description: Thresholds are fixed per version; the validator requires the published values.

attemptConditionsV2.description: Readiness endpoint, sampled run and after endpoint. Open to additive fields.

chargingStates.description: onBattery is present exactly under charging-policy-v3 (checked by the validator).

conditionSnapshotV2.description: A v2 endpoint snapshot or monitor sample: typed and ranged like conditions.ts normalizeConditions, where invalid readings become null. pssMb exists only on endpoint snapshots.

chargingPolicyV2.description: charging-policy-v2: as v3, but DISCHARGING counts as unknown (earlier builds).

chargingPolicyV3.description: charging-policy-v3 (tethered-not-charging): external power allowed; eligible only when batteryStatus is FULL or NOT_CHARGING at every snapshot and sample; DISCHARGING is the known, ineligible on-battery state; current_now is diagnostic only.

readiness.description: record-only-experiment only with configuration.experimentChargingReadiness (experiment only, never publication evidence).

acceleratorModelFile.description: accelerator-v1: a GGUF (llama.cpp) or .litertlm (LiteRT-LM) basename; the engine/extension pairing is checked by raw_session.py.

configurationV2.description: accelerator-v1 configuration (config.ts parseAcceleratorConfig), echoed exactly as parsed.

backendEvidence.description: Per-repetition backend evidence read right after load (backend.ts); status is recomputed by raw_session.py.

observedBackend.description: Summary of the repetitions' backendEvidence: any mismatch wins, else the weakest status; null before any load.

correctness.description: output-gate-v1 (gate.ts): greedy probes answered by this engine/backend before measurement and compared with the CPU reference run of the same engine. Status and probe verdicts are recomputed by raw_session.py.

comparison.description: Whether this session's metrics may be compared across backends: invalid for bug-repro runs, a failed gate or an engine-reported backend mismatch (metrics are kept), unverified when the gate could not decide.

completeAttemptAcceleratorV2.description: accelerator-v1 successful repetition: completeAttemptV2 plus observedBackend.

failedAttemptAcceleratorV2.description: accelerator-v1 failed repetition: failedAttemptV2 plus observedBackend (null if it never loaded).

effectiveSettingsLlamaRnAccelerator.description: accelerator-v1 llama.cpp runs: effectiveSettingsLlamaRn with GPU/NPU offload (n_gpu_layers, devices).

distribution.description: The binding as installed: the npm package as published, with no patches applied. Absent in records from apps built before it was recorded.

completeAttemptAcceleratorV1.description: accelerator-v1 successful repetition: completeAttemptV2 plus observedBackend.

failedAttemptAcceleratorV1.description: accelerator-v1 failed repetition: failedAttemptV2 plus observedBackend (null if it never loaded).

artifact.description: null only for runs recorded without measurement (stopReason setup-failed, configuration-aborted, engine-unavailable or gate-cleanup-failed).

protocol.description: accelerator-v1 protocol; cpu-reference-v2 fields plus prompt format, sampling and gate version.

guardsPassed.description: Never true: backend execution is unverified even when conditionVerdict passes.

gateBackend.description: Backend evidence from the correctness gate's load, the first load of this run in the process; null when the gate did not load the engine.

sessionAcceleratorV1.description: Protocol accelerator-v1 (harness xebench-0.7-accelerator), frozen: records of the app built before the build/execution identity work, without build, configurationSource, effectiveSettings or executionReports. New builds write accelerator-v2 (sessionAcceleratorV2).

expectedSha256.description: The configured run's modelSha256, or null when the configuration names none.

artifact.description: null only for runs recorded without measurement (stopReason setup-failed, configuration-aborted, engine-unavailable or gate-cleanup-failed).

protocol.description: accelerator-v2 protocol; cpu-reference-v3 fields plus prompt format, sampling and gate version.

guardsPassed.description: Never true: backend execution is unverified even when conditionVerdict passes.

effectiveSettings.description: llama.cpp runs: every parameter passed to llama.rn. LiteRT-LM runs: null (LiteRtBenchModule.kt states its parameters in code).

executionReports.description: One engine report per successful model load, in load order. Reports are what the engine said, not verified execution; observedBackend stays null.

gateBackend.description: Backend evidence from the correctness gate's load, the first load of this run in the process; null when the gate did not load the engine.

sessionAcceleratorV2.description: Protocol accelerator-v2 (harness xebench-0.8-accelerator): cpu-reference-v3 repetitions, conditions and identity evidence for llama.cpp and LiteRT-LM on cpu/gpu/npu, with observed-backend evidence and the output-gate-v1 correctness gate (docs/experiments/litert-accelerators.md).
